meta.purpose: Content source for the public marketing page: features, why-choose-us, and category comparison for Dynamic Tags.

time_saved.label: saved on every WooCommerce, ACF, or membership site you build
time_saved.detail: Without it, showing a product's price, a member's custom field, or a filtered list of posts inside a page builder means custom PHP snippets or a paid add-on per data source. One merge-tag syntax reaches WooCommerce, ACF, user/term meta, queries, and external APIs — so a placeholder that used to take a support ticket and a code edit now takes one line.

hero.headline: One merge tag for every piece of data on your site
hero.subheadline: Drop {wc:price}, {acf:field}, or a live query straight into Elementor, Gutenberg, or Divi — no custom PHP, no per-integration add-on, no waiting on a developer.

features.title: Complete merge-tag engine, free forever
features.pitch: Post, taxonomy, author, site, URL, and date placeholders work everywhere — no paid tier required to start.
features.detail: Formatters like |upper, |currency, and |date, plus fallback syntax ({token??default}) and built-in conditionals (user_logged_in, is_mobile, user_role:), are all on the Free plan.

features.title: WooCommerce fields without a snippet
features.pitch: {wc:price}, {wc:sku}, {wc:stock_status}, {wc:categories} — drop them into any builder, on any template.
features.detail: No custom loop, no theme-file edit — the same tag syntax you already use for post fields reaches straight into WooCommerce product data.

features.title: ACF repeaters, galleries, and relationships
features.pitch: Scalar ACF fields are free forever; repeater/gallery/relationship fields unlock the array layer.
features.detail: {acf:field.subfield} walks into repeater and relationship structures directly in a merge tag — no PHP loop written by hand.

features.title: [dt_loop] — iterate any array-returning source
features.pitch: Render a product grid, a team list, or a repeater field as a real loop, inside any builder.
features.detail: Combine with [dt_template] for per-record rendering — product cards, team grids, testimonial rows — without a dedicated loop widget or a second plugin.

features.title: Field-based conditionals and block visibility
features.pitch: Show or hide entire sections based on real data, not just built-in flags.
features.detail: {if:wc:price>50}, contains, and other field comparisons drive [dt_if]/[dt_else] block-level visibility — merchandising and personalization without a rules-engine plugin.

features.title: {query:...} and {api:...} as data sources
features.pitch: Pull in a filtered set of posts, or a live external JSON feed, as just another merge tag.
features.detail: Query posts as a reusable data source for [dt_loop], or reach an external API and format the response the same way — no custom fetch code, no companion plugin.

features.title: Conflict detection, import/export, migration — free forever
features.pitch: Ops tooling never sits behind a paywall, on any plan.
features.detail: Conflict detection between tag names/shortcodes, JSON/CSV/XML/SQL import-export, and dual-storage migration tooling ship free, so moving or auditing tags never costs extra.

features.title: Works in any builder, always
features.pitch: Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, or a plain widget — the same tags work everywhere, on every plan.
features.detail: No builder-specific integration to install or configure. If it accepts text, it accepts a Dynamic Tags placeholder.

why_choose_us.title: Free is a complete plugin, not a trial
why_choose_us.detail: Up to 15 dynamic tags, every core placeholder, every formatter, and all ops tooling (conflict detection, import/export, migration) work fully on Free — nothing here is crippled to force an upgrade.

why_choose_us.title: One syntax reaches every data source
why_choose_us.detail: WooCommerce, ACF, user/term meta, queries, and external APIs all resolve through the same {tag} syntax — no separate integration to learn per data source.

why_choose_us.title: Nothing runs outside your site
why_choose_us.detail: Tag resolution happens on your own WordPress install. {api:...} is the only placeholder that reaches outside your server, and only when you point it at one.

why_choose_us.title: Non-destructive by design
why_choose_us.detail: The 15-tag Free cap is checked only when you create a new tag — downgrading from Paid never disables or deletes a tag you already built.

why_choose_us.title: Transparent, low-friction pricing
why_choose_us.detail: $2/month or $19/year unlocks the entire dynamic-data layer — one site, one price, no quote-only enterprise tier to negotiate.
